backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all data types (Post, Reply, Listing, UserProfile, Message, Conversation, Admin types) and implementing forum, marketplace, messaging, user profile, and admin functionality with access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report with no features documented.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components, pages, hooks, and configuration files describing French UI with tutoiement, GDPR compliance, authentication flows, and marketplace features.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component managing tabs (home, forum, secondhand, profile, chat, admin), authentication state, profile setup dialog, and routing with reduced blocking on profile loading.
frontend/src/components/AppErrorBoundary: React error boundary component displaying French error UI with reload button when uncaught errors occur.
frontend/src/components/CreateListingDia: Dialog form for creating second-hand listings with image upload (max 5 photos, 5MB each), Swiss canton region selection, category checkboxes, GDPR compliance check, and progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/CreatePostDialog: Dialog form for creating forum posts with category selection, anonymous posting toggle, GDPR compliance check, and warm French microcopy using tutoiement.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileDialo: Dialog component for editing user profile with fields for name, country, region, motherhood status, bio, email, marketing opt-in, and profile picture upload with progress tracking. Handles image validation (type, size), upload to ExternalBlob, and saves profile via useSaveCallerUserProfile hook.
frontend/src/components/FeedPostCard.tsx: Card component displaying a forum post with author info, timestamp, content (with expand/collapse for long posts), category and status badges, and action buttons for reply, bookmark, and report. Formats timestamps relative to current time and maps category/status enums to French labels.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer component displaying "Fait avec ❤️ par Nara" with responsive layout and styling.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with logo, navigation tabs (Home, Forum, Secondhand, My Profile), and authentication button. Manages active tab state, displays user avatar with initials when authenticated, and handles login/logout via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/ListingCard.tsx: Card component for marketplace listings showing product images (with carousel navigation), title, price, condition, region, timestamp, and favorite toggle. Opens ListingDetailDialog on click and provides profile view action.
frontend/src/components/ListingDetailDia: Full-screen dialog displaying detailed listing information with image carousel, seller info, product details, and action buttons for favoriting, messaging seller, and viewing profile. Integrates GDPR compliance check before sending messages.
frontend/src/components/LoggedOutStateCa: Reusable card component prompting unauthenticated users to log in, with customizable title, description, and action text. Triggers Internet Identity login flow on button click.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: A card component that displays a post preview with category badge, author, timestamp, content snippet, and a reply indicator. Includes click handling and French timestamp formatting.
frontend/src/components/PostDetailDialog: A dialog component that shows full post details with replies in a scrollable area, allows authenticated users to submit replies (anonymous or named), and integrates GDPR compliance checks before posting.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: A modal dialog for new users to set up their profile by entering name, selecting country (Switzerland or France), region, and motherhood status. Cannot be dismissed until completed.
frontend/src/components/RulesAcceptanceD: A dialog that displays community rules and collects user email with GDPR consent checkboxes (rules acceptance and marketing opt-in) before allowing content creation actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance, handling both authenticated and anonymous actors, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useGDPRCompliance.ts: A hook that checks if users have accepted rules and provided email, shows the rules dialog if not compliant, and queues actions to execute after compliance is achieved.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: A React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and providing login/logout functions with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend API interactions including user profiles, forum posts, listings, messaging, admin operations, and GDPR compliance. Includes authentication error detection and query invalidation logic.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global CSS with Tailwind layers, custom CSS variables for a soft orange/peach color theme supporting light and dark modes, and imports DM Serif Display font for headings.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and wraps the app with InternetIdentityProvider and QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboardPage.ts: Admin dashboard page displaying moderation queue, recent activity, and stats with actions to hide/delete posts and listings. Includes content detail viewing dialogs and authentication checks.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: One-on-one messaging interface showing conversation history with another user, message sending with GDPR compliance checks, and special handling for Swiss users with no conversations.
frontend/src/pages/ForumPage.tsx: Forum page displaying posts filtered by category tabs (pregnancy, postpartum, sleep, organization, mental load) with create post dialog and authentication prompts.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero section promoting the community, call-to-action buttons for creating posts and joining, and a feed of recent forum posts sorted by timestamp.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: React component displaying user profile with tabs for listings, posts, and favorites. Supports viewing own profile or other users' profiles, with edit functionality and chat/messaging integration.
frontend/src/pages/SecondHandPage.tsx: React component for the second-hand marketplace (vide dressing) with listing creation, filtering by category/age/region, and favorites management. Restricts French users from creating listings.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and persisting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for parameter persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom colors (including marketplace theme), typography, container settings, animations, and design tokens using OKLCH color space.
project_state.json: Project state file documenting a fix request for a 403 blob storage authorization error preventing users from uploading images when creating vide dressing listings.
